summary_paragraph: A male patient with cryptogenic cirrhosis was admitted due to altered mental status after stopping lactulose. He improved rapidly after restarting lactulose and having a bowel movement. A diagnostic paracentesis showed no signs of infection, ruling out spontaneous bacterial peritonitis. His mental status normalized, and labs showed stable liver function with slight improvement. Hyperkalemia resolved with treatment, and creatinine was mildly elevated. He was discharged home with continued lactulose, diuretics, and PPI, while discontinuing nadolol and Noroxin. Follow-up was arranged with his liver specialist.
